theorems.name: Submission.ts_blowup_closedBall_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (c : ℝ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → Module.finrank ℝ P = n → 0 < c → (∀ f : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (c * ∫ y in (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), f y ∂μHE[n]))) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μ.real (closedBall x ρ) / (omega n * ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 c)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
